title: Quantum encodings of the fourteen pair colours and the geometric quantum lift
research_target: Three exact results were independently checked within the same model family. (1) A six-moment mixed encoding has the same product density but a different exact initial drift, -3/3584. (2) Affine covariant single-pair density encodings lose the cubic colour moment; a positive encoding with a readable quadratic observable has an exact drift difference of 1/57344. (3) Positive covariant states on two pair spaces (dimension 16), with column rank 14 and affine rank 13, retain all fourteen probabilities. The campaign report names what remains open: injectivity supplies neither perfect colour readout nor a completely positive evolution implementing the rates. For the two-pair encoding, decide whether a completely positive generator on the encoded states reproduces the specified colour rates, or exhibit an obstruction. Alternatively, test the quantum-lift boundary of the geometric singlet channel and fibre construction.
completion_criterion: A proof under explicit premises, an exact counterexample, or a checked partial result identifying the first unresolved step; RECOVERY_STATUS.json says whether the result is ready for a science PR.
